verdicts.reason: A is a reasonable left-to-right banner: can in the centre, with the headline, copy and CTA grouped on the right. Its flaws: the NEW FLAVOR badge is jammed into the top-left corner, the CTA nearly touches the right edge, and the small SOLSTICE logo floats on its own under the badge in the left column. B breaks the typography: the headline wraps awkwardly to 'Chase the / Light', and the body copy is squeezed into a narrow five-line column ending in the orphan 'hour.'. That copy also sits cut off between the can and the headline/CTA group, and the bloated background circles crowd the badge and logo.
